notes.title: v1.2 Update - Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hi everybody,

We just released a major content and navigation improvement update.

Here's what's new:

[list]
[*][b]Distance levels (9 new levels)[/b]: Put some power into it! Hit targets that are far, far away.
[*][b]High/low levels (9 new levels)[/b]: These levels contain only high and low targets which will be a pain in the neck to hit.
[*][b]Corner kick levels (9 new levels)[/b]: We added corner kicks by popular demand (also because they're a lot of fun).
[*][b]Improved menu navigation[/b]: Now you won't have to go through player customization every time you select Single Player.
[*][b]Retry level button[/b]: Now you'll be able to replay a level without having to go through the menu again.
[/list]

This update increases the available number of levels from [b]18 to 45[/b]!

Enjoy the new levels and thanks for playing Hat Trick Header.

notes.title: Upcoming v1.2 update - Lots of New Levels and Improved Menu Navigation
notes.notes:
Hi everybody,

Here's what we're working on:
[list]
    [*][b]Sniper mode levels (9 new levels)[/b]: Put some power into it! Hit targets that are far, far away.
    [*][b]High/low mode levels (9 new levels)[/b]: These levels contain only high and low targets which will be a pain in the neck to hit.
    [*][b]Corner kick mode levels (9 new levels)[/b]: We're adding corner kicks by popular demand (also because they're a lot of fun).
    [*][b]Improved menu navigation[/b]: Now you won't have to go through player customization every time you select Single Player.
    [*][b]Replay level button[/b]: Now you'll be able to replay a level without having to go through the menu again.
[/list]
This is a big content update which will increase the number of unique levels from 18 to 45 ([b]more than 2x[/b])! 

We're planning to release the update in the coming few weeks.

Thanks for playing Hat Trick Header!
